name: copilot-app
description: The Copilot host profile: it binds the delivery engine's host slots to Copilot's own files and capabilities — repo-instructions to .github/copilot-instructions.md, stage-delegation to custom agents, surface to delivery-canvas — and ships the one procedure that belongs to this host rather than to the engine: update-open-sessions, which brings every open Copilot session worktree back in step with the trunk. Declares no dependency: the flows themselves live in delivery, and a binding nothing reads is inert.
